title: Structure of the eye, defects of vision, and dispersion of light.

concepts.name: Structure of the Eye
concepts.real_life_application: When you squint to read a distant board, your eye's lens is doing the same job a camera lens does — focusing light onto a screen.
day_to_day_usage: Eyes adjusting when entering a dark theatre
concepts.industry_relevance: Optometry, LASIK surgery, camera and AR/VR optics.

exercises.question: Why does a rainbow appear after rain?
exercises.solution: Rain drops act like prisms, dispersing sunlight into its component colours. Each colour refracts at a different angle, forming a rainbow.
